item.title: Reports: Penn State Safeties Coach Anthony Poindexter Hired by Tennessee
item.description: A key Penn State position coach is out the door. After five successful seasons as safeties coach and co-defensive coordinator in Happy Valley, Anthony Poindexter has been hired for the same roles at Tennessee, according to multiple reports Friday morning, including ESPN's Pete Thamel. It's unclear whether head coach Matt Campbell attempted to retain Poindexter, but it's a big loss for the program regardless. item.title: Former Penn State OC Andy Kotelnicki Returning to Kansas
item.description: Updated 5:18 p.m. Jan. 2 Andy Kotelnicki is headed back to The Sunflower State. After two seasons as Penn State's offensive coordinator, Kotelnicki has been hired as an associate head coach at Kansas, the Jayhawks confirmed on Friday following a report by Yahoo Sports' Ross Dellenger. Kotelnicki worked as the Jayhawks' offensive coordinator from 2021-23, leading a stark turnaround and earning a nomination for the Broyles Award, presented annually to the top coordinator in college football. item.title: Big Time Rush Cancels Bryce Jordan Center Show
item.description: Pop group Big Time Rush has canceled its upcoming "College Dropout" tour, including a performances scheduled for Penn State's Bryce Jordan Center in February. The group wrote in a social media post on Tuesday that their tour across the United States and Europe in 2025 has "taken a toll... and on doctors orders we need to pause to focus on our overall health as we've all sustained some form of prolonged illness and injuries." item.title: Lawsuit Alleges State College Restaurant Security Staff Assaulted, Injured Man
item.description: A New Jersey man's lawsuit claims he was left with injuries requiring spinal surgery after he was accosted by security staff at a downtown State College restaurant and bar. Scott Somers' complaint filed Wednesday in federal court accuses Primanti Bros. and its parent company of "negligent, reckless and wanton conduct" that led to the incident on Feb. 24, 2024 at the 130 Hiester St. restaurant. item.title: Report: Penn State Hiring Tyson Veidt as Linebackers Coach
item.description: Penn State's coaching staff continues to fill out. The Nittany Lions are hiring Tyson Veidt as their next linebackers coach, according to a report by 247Sports' Keegan Nickoson. Veidt spent the previous two seasons as Cincinnati's defensive coordinator, but they've agreed to a mutual parting of ways, according to the report.
